# Temple Scroll Column 29 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 29 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**29:1** Consecrate them all — they shall be holy. Set apart the altar as supremely sacred.

**29:2** Consecrate the washing basin and its stand and set them apart; they too shall be supremely sacred.

**29:3** Consecrate the entire inner court — the altar, the sanctuary, the basin, the colonnade, and every vessel used in worship. All of it shall be supremely sacred forever.

**29:4** Consecrate the middle court as well — its colonnades, rooms, and gates. It shall be holy.

**29:5** Consecrate them, and they shall become for Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation, just as I told Moses on the day I brought Israel out of Egypt.

**29:6** The innermost sanctuary, the holy place, the altar area, and the courts — together these form the dwelling place of My name.

**29:7** For I will fill it with My glory until the day of blessing, when I Myself will create My own temple and establish it forever.

**29:8** This fulfills the covenant I made with Jacob at Bethel and the promise I gave to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

**29:9** I will make the land holy — like the Garden of Eden — and the earth will glow like the sun and moon, for I will live in the midst of it.

**29:10** My glory will rest upon it. I will never drive them from My presence, and they will know that I am the LORD their God.

**29:11** They will be My people and I will be their God. The king over My people will stand before Me always.

**29:12** They will be a kingdom of priests — a holy nation — living before Me in the land I give them.

**29:13** The holy land will stretch from the Egyptian wilderness to the eastern wilderness, and from the coast of the Mediterranean to the Euphrates River.

**29:14** The land and everything in it will be holy to Me — every harvest, every crop. The tithes and firstfruits shall go to My sanctuary.

**29:15** The whole world will come to know that I am the God of Israel, the father of all Jacob's children.

**29:16** I will reign over them forever, from now through every generation to come, for I am the LORD their God.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 29 well preserved. This is the visionary climax of the temple section. The "day of blessing" (v.7) anticipates a future temple of divine rather than human construction — a revolutionary theological concept. The Eden imagery and cosmic scope (vv.9, 13, 15) transform the architectural blueprint into eschatological prophecy. "Mediterranean" used for "Great Sea" for modern readers.*
